lines.1: Someone tapped me on the shoulder, so I turned around.
lines.6: 「You're thinking of recruiting that girl who just left, aren't you?」
lines.7: 「She'd be a fantastic asset. That brazen attitude of hers is perfect.」
lines.8: 「And she's beautiful. I never imagined we had such a rare specimen among the first-years.」
lines.9: 「Make absolutely sure you recruit her. Pull it off in style, and I'll give you three Kiriya stamps at once.」
lines.10: With that, the Princess skipped away.
lines.11: 「...Hey, what now? Her Highness really took a liking to that girl.」
lines.12: 「Three stamps means we've got no choice but to do it.」
lines.13: 「Getting her on the council and working her to the bone doesn't sound bad either.」
lines.14: 「I probably don't have anything but a bad reputation. Same goes for Crab.」
lines.15: 「So either Leo or I has to go...」
